title_en: Ibn Taymiyya's Stance on the Hadith That God Created Adam in His Image (Part 5)
description_en: Ibn Taymiyya's stance on the hadith that God created Adam in his image, Part 5. The program 'Divine Unity' (Tawhid) by His Eminence, the religious authority (marja') Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari, broadcast on Al-Kawthar TV channel.
summary: Part five discussing Ibn Taymiyya's interpretation of the hadith regarding the creation of Adam in the divine image.
